chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from ʿAlī ibn Sayf, from al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿĀmir, from Aḥmad ibn Rizq al-Ghumshānī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Our wilayah is the wilayah of Allah, without which He never sent any Prophet at all except with it.

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah; the Divine whose wilayah is the source of all true authority
key_terms.بِهَا: with it; meaning with this wilayah as part of the divine mission
key_terms.نَبِيًّا: a Prophet; one sent by Allah with revelation and mission
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: wilayah; authority, guardianship, and divinely established allegiance
key_terms.وَلَايَتُنَا: our wilayah; the divinely ordained authority and guardianship of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the relationship between the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt and the wilayah of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام is inseparably bound to the wilayah of Allah. It presents wilayah as a foundational divine reality accompanying every prophetic mission.
